Definition: from G2596 and G1402; to enslave utterly:--bring into bondage.
BiblicalUsage: Paul names the men who bring the church into bondage, false brethren who slip in to spy out our liberty and enslave the free.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe freedom in Christ is worth guarding, because bondage always comes back dressed as religion.
